title: Chapter 1396 - 12: Twenty Thousand Years (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1396 - 12: Twenty Thousand Years (Part 2)

Chapter 1396: Chapter 12: Twenty Thousand Years (Part 2)

"Even if we want to stop it, can we really stop it?"

The figure on the Immortal Palace throne replied noncommittally, "Who will stop him? Who can withstand the current strength of Emperor Tianyuan?"

An ancient supreme being fully revived, couldn’t withstand even a slap from Emperor Tianyuan, and those forbidden zones couldn’t last more than a dozen breaths in front of him.

Emperor Tianyuan’s strength is at least that of a supreme Emperor Level, close to the Red Dust Immortal’s supreme level.

Even if all the foundations of the Bronze Immortal Palace were brought out, at most, they could only gain the upper hand and absolutely couldn’t suppress him.

The Bronze Immortal Palace was left by the Red Dust Immortals when they departed, but at best, it can exert the combat power of a Red Dust Immortal, with many constraints and consumptions.

Attempting to suppress a supreme emperor close to the Red Dust Immortal is nothing short of a fool’s dream.

Back when the Red Dust Immortals were about to leave, they already knew that the world environment would gradually deteriorate. In the future, not to mention the birth of new Red Dust Immortals, even Great Emperors would become incredibly rare and difficult.

Leaving behind a Bronze Immortal Palace was already more than sufficient.

"I want to see how far this Emperor Tianyuan will go in the future."

The figure on the Immortal Palace throne said meaningfully. In such a harsh world environment, Emperor Tianyuan has cultivated to this level and can easily live out the fourth and fifth generations.

...

Outside a towering divine mountain.

Lin Yuan appeared out of thin air.

His arrival caused the entire divine mountain to be on high alert, with supreme auras awakening one after another, and several Emperor-level weapons also reviving.

The grand divine mountain, named ’Emperor God Mountain’, is the first forbidden zone in the Great Wilderness Origin World. Even at his peak, Emperor Tianyuan dared not approach it.

Compared to those powerful races, the existence of forbidden zones is even more terrifying and their origins unimaginable.

"Tianyuan, what brings you here?"

At this moment, a man clad in divine armor walked out of Emperor God Mountain, his gaze sharp.

As the first forbidden zone, Emperor God Mountain naturally knew of Lin Yuan’s actions of erasing forbidden zones one by one.

Otherwise, a mere contemporary Great Emperor wouldn’t be taken so seriously by Emperor God Mountain.

"To level you down."

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

In the many timelines he observed, during multiple dark upheavals in the Great Wilderness Origin World, ancient supreme beings struck to harvest all living things, all pushed by Emperor God Mountain from behind the scenes.

Even after the original Emperor Tianyuan sat down and perished, if the timeline developed normally, most of the Great Emperor’s Origin Sources would eventually fall into the hands of Emperor God Mountain.

"Level us down?"

The man in divine armor looked at Lin Yuan.

He himself is an Emperor-level powerhouse, clad in Emperor-level armor. Even if he is not a contemporary Great Emperor or at his peak period, he has enough confidence.

"Press."

Lin Yuan didn’t waste words and directly made a move.

The heavens and earth darkened, and Lin Yuan’s hand stretched out, pressing down a colossal hand towards Emperor God Mountain.

Rumble.

Dazzling divine light erupted from the surface of Emperor God Mountain, and one Emperor-level fluctuation after another burst out, but it was all in vain, annihilated under Lin Yuan’s palm.

"No!!"

The man in divine armor tried to block the slowly descending colossal hand, but it was all in vain, as futile as an ant shaking a tree, utterly meaningless.

"Emperor Tianyuan, do you know the origins of my Emperor God Mountain?"

In the last moment, the man in divine armor stared at Lin Yuan and said, "My Emperor God Mountain is a lineage of the Red Dust Immortals. In the past, the Red Dust Immortals made great contributions to this land, you cannot treat us like this."

"The Red Dust Immortals indeed have great meritorious deeds for this world."

Lin Yuan nodded, having seen past and future timelines and knew the achievements of the Red Dust Immortals of this Fang Yuan World.

Even the undying substances permeating the world were introduced from a higher plane by the first Red Dust Immortal at great cost.

This led to the birth of the second and third Red Dust Immortals, and so on.

"But what do the achievements of the Red Dust Immortals have to do with you?" Lin Yuan looked at the man in divine armor and said indifferently.

Relying on the merits of ancestors to harvest all living things, Lin Yuan naturally had no good feelings. Since he decided to take action to settle accounts, he was fully prepared, not fearing retribution from the Red Dust Immortals in higher planes.

Moreover, the actions of Emperor God Mountain and other forbidden zones, if truly known by the Red Dust Immortals backing them, would probably lead to them being cleansed from the inside without needing him to make a move.

Crash.

Emperor God Mountain shook and quickly collapsed.

Lin Yuan retracted his right hand, collecting a vast array of treasures and the undying substances Emperor God Mountain held into his internal universe.

"Red Dust Immortals..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep. Even before the future of this Fang Yuan World, he knew that the Red Dust Immortals of the thirteenth tier were gathered in another realm.

That realm is deep within this Fang Yuan World, and the undying substances that permeated the Great Wilderness Origin World were derived from there.

To advance further, and for the cultivation path of worldly beings, the Red Dust Immortals were preparing to fully open the Immortal Path, linking the Great Wilderness Origin World with the world at the end of the Immortal Path, thus transforming it into an unprecedented holy realm of cultivation.

"With my current strength, I’m not yet fit to intervene in the world at the end of the Immortal Path."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head. Breaking into the Immortal Path can’t be done by ordinary Red Dust Immortals.

The Red Dust Immortals of this Fang Yuan World once teamed up, and even those above the Red Dust Immortals intervened, to enter the Immortal Path.

What Lin Yuan needs to do now is continue to transform himself using the undying substances and enhance his strength as much as possible.

...

After cleansing most forbidden zones and powerful clans of the Great Wilderness Origin World,

Lin Yuan returned to the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

As for the few forbidden zones that were not cleansed?

Those zones did not participate in past dark upheavals, nor did they covet the fleshly Origin Source of the original Emperor Tianyuan.

Although Lin Yuan is decisive in killing, he does not kill without reason, so he did not attack these forbidden zones.

"Great Emperor."

Outside the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, many followers had been waiting for a long time.

Even many high-ranking members of the Human Race gathered there. Lin Yuan’s actions of cleansing races and forbidden zones clearly didn’t align with the behavior of a late-emperor life.

The upper echelons of the Human Race evacuated the Tianyuan Emperor Palace because Emperor Tianyuan was nearing his lifespan limit, making the palace unsafe.

Now, with Lin Yuan’s strength and means, there was no safer place in the world than the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

"You all have come."

Lin Yuan swept his gaze over the dozens of Human Race high officials.

These Human Race high officials were excited. They had initially prepared for the Human Race to enter a dark age.

After all, as Emperor Tianyuan was on the verge of sitting down, and without a new Great Emperor being born, the days ahead were not expected to be smooth.

But who would have thought Emperor Tianyuan possessed such terrifying strength?

"Great Emperor, have you lived out your third generation?"

A middle-aged man couldn’t help but ask. He was a direct great-grandson of Emperor Tianyuan, with high talent and aptitude, and the most promising to become the next Great Emperor of the Human Race.

"More or less."

Lin Yuan said casually.

He had not just lived out the third generation. His insight into the mind and will of time and life eliminated any lifespan limitation, allowing him to live as long as he wished, remaining carefree even in the face of the Great Destruction of this Fang Yuan World.

"Next, I will be retreating in the Emperor Palace, continue with your tasks as usual."

Lin Yuan advised a few words, then returned to the depths of the Emperor Palace to continue his secluded cultivation.

Having cleansed numerous clan forbidden zones, Lin Yuan gained abundantly, with enough undying substances alone to allow him to digest for a period of time.

In fact, those ancient supreme beings valued their own condensed undying substances extremely. Even if they perished, they would burn their undying substances in advance to prevent their enemies from obtaining them.

But Lin Yuan’s absolute overwhelming power left the opponents without a chance to burn their undying substances.

...

Since Emperor Tianyuan took action to flatten many forbidden zones,

The Human Race once again ushered in an era of flourishment in cultivation. Without forbidden zones lurking in the shadows, and without major clans striking them down, many talented cultivation geniuses of the Human Race didn’t need to hide but instead showcased their talents as much as possible.

As for Lin Yuan? He scarcely made further moves. With the record of sweeping away many clan forbidden zones, what ancient supreme would dare come out to cause trouble?

Time thus passed swiftly.

In the blink of an eye, twenty thousand years had passed.
